title: Static server build includes an obsoleted driver header
summary: indigo_server.c includes ccd_gphoto2/indigo_ccd_gphoto2.h under STATIC_DRIVERS and INDIGO_LINUX, but the driver lives in obsoleted_drivers/, so a STATIC_DRIVERS build cannot compile. Pre-existing, found while checking the scheduler registration. Next: drop or guard the include and entry.
evidence: indigo_server/indigo_server.c:224; gcc -fsyntax-only -DSTATIC_DRIVERS failed without -I../obsoleted_drivers, see verification.md.
